recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Because source/oids.ini is an OID registry file, product-director/human review remains appropriate, but the edit is the bounded source correction needed for the applied Jira decision and follows both WG guidance and repository rename practice.
issue_request: FHIR-43648 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It requested moving the ExampleScenario actor-type ValueSet to ActorDefinition, renaming it to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/actordefinition-actor-type, and the resolution also required renaming the CodeSystem.
initial_application: PR #3354 merged as 8e71abb11c5737e3f165c33fdea01e2b90184f35 and moved the CodeSystem and ValueSet source files into source/actordefinition, renamed their canonical URLs, and updated ActorDefinition.type and ExampleScenario.actor.type bindings. It did not update source/oids.ini, leaving active OID registry entries assigned to the old examplescenario-actor-type URLs.
additional_context: FHIR Workflow minutes for 2024-01-22 corroborate the persuasive-with-modification decision. A 2025 Zulip thread for FHIR-43648 and FHIR-44475 explicitly discussed keeping the existing OIDs after the rename, and Lloyd McKenzie said that was fine. Later FHIR-50087 refines ActorDefinition.type/category and a future THO move but does not undo the actordefinition-actor-type canonical rename. Recent source commits for other terminology renames update source/oids.ini URLs while retaining OID values.
reconciliation: Changed source/oids.ini so the existing OIDs 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.3.858 and 2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.4.859 now map to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/actordefinition-actor-type and http://hl7.org/fhir/actordefinition-actor-type. The stale ExampleScenario SVG link was left untouched because the authoritative XML source is correct and the workflow guardrail excludes generated-looking diagram-only edits.
source_changes: source/oids.ini: updated the actor-type ValueSet and CodeSystem canonical URL keys from examplescenario-actor-type to actordefinition-actor-type while preserving their assigned OID values.

related_jiras.note: Actor-type concept changes were coordinated with FHIR-43648 during implementation, but the content changes are a separate decision and were not reconciled here.
Later resolved-change-required work refines ActorDefinition.type/category and THO migration plans without reversing the FHIR-43648 canonical rename.
